{{Top|leg}}
The '''Executor-50.x engine''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for use in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]]. The [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] was equipped with thirteen massive Executor-50.x engines.
